escena: a farmer in the green highlands of El Progreso, San Cristóbal, stands between two small plots of plants: on the left plot with wet dark soil and a watering can the plants grew tall and lush after a sack of fertilizer; on the right plot of dry cracked soil with the same sack the plants are small; a giant tortoise walks between the plots.

a shop owner in a small store of Puerto Baquerizo Moreno holds up big cut-paper price tags over two tables: on one table office chairs and bookshelves and on the other table laptops and phones; she looks thoughtful comparing them; a sea lion peeks through the door.
